status: Native-package false-pass reproduction and candidate fix validated; not live cluster validation or established journal novelty
implementation: Unmodified Kube-burner v2.5.1 measurement callback, HTTP result processing, normalization, quantiles and threshold evaluation executed in the native package. Test objects and proxy response timestamps are synthetic. Informer delivery, actual proxy/client pods and CNI are not exercised.

primary_result.cause: Two namespaces with same-named policies share a timestamp key and a result-group key. The later creation overwrites the earlier one and produces a negative observation. Aggregation merges the two identities.

scope_of_counts: Four deterministic cases per implementation; not failure-rate estimates or statistical samples.
fix: analysis/native-namespace-fix.patch uses namespace/name for callback timestamps and probe attribution. Native prepareConnections is additionally exercised using the Kubernetes fake client and a two-namespace policy template. This validates mapping construction separately; actual API/proxy/CNI deployment remains untested. Candidate patch is not upstream accepted.

workload_census.method: Actual pinned Go template rendered with Sprig, parsed as Kubernetes policies, then flow-to-policy memberships enumerated at probe port 8080. Unique-witness criterion is a restricted static probe criterion, not a new algorithm.
workload_census.example: 9 policies, 34 distinct probe flows, no shared flows, all nine policies have a unique probe.
workload_census.controlled_variant: 180 policies, 153 distinct probe flows, all shared, no policy with a unique probe; up to five policies share a flow.
workload_census.limit: Variant changes policy count in the same template. It is not evidence that the default example or production deployments have this overlap.

novelty_boundary: Namespace-key correction is standard engineering. ATPG discusses indistinguishable rules and NetCov formalizes strong/weak configuration coverage. No novel general attribution or coverage method established. A narrower empirical study of benchmark validity may be worth pursuing if end-to-end evidence and broader impact survive review.
execution_notes: Harness preflight corrected callback input from typed to unstructured objects and used whole-second creation timestamps before successful execution.
The saved comparison runner initially refused an encoding-mismatched source read; explicit UTF-8 fixed the runner. No upstream source was overwritten by that refused run.
Final baseline and fixed logs are saved. Upstream source was restored after comparison.

Additional fake-client mapping test initially lacked cached dependencies; failed offline setup logs retained. Added two test-only indirect modules in native-test-dependencies.patch and rebuilt. Final baseline and fixed runs each passed four attribution cases and one mapping test.
remaining: Independent end-to-end reproduction with actual API objects and proxy/client lifecycle
